title: AI Quality Lead
description: <p><strong><em>AI Quality Lead | Tripadvisor </em></strong></p> <p><strong>About Tripadvisor </strong></p> <p>The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.</p> <p><em>Job Location: Hybrid</em></p> <p><em>This role is a hybrid position that requires 1-2 days per week in our London office.</em></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What are we looking for?</strong></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">We are seeking a detail-oriented <strong>AI QA Lead</strong> to monitor, test, and evaluate our AI-driven customer experiences to ensure effortless, accurate, and scalable support for all our customers. This role focuses on the end-to-end quality of the customer support journey - from Self-Service and AI-Assist through to Human-Assist transitions. Ideal for a hands-on quality specialist with strong process validation experience, this role bridges customer feedback with technical tuning to continuously improve response accuracy, system compliance, and overall resolution quality.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul data-pm-slice="3 3 []"> <li> <p><strong>Quality Framework & Testing:</strong> Design and execute QA frameworks, test scripts, and evaluation criteria specifically for AI chatbots, automated workflows, and agent copilot tools.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Performance Monitoring:</strong> Continuously audit and analyze real-time AI conversations and self-service flows to identify intent misclassifications, hallucinations, inaccurate answers, or broken customer journeys.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Closed-Loop Quality Feedback:</strong> Identify root causes of AI accuracy failures and customer friction; feed actionable insights directly back to AI Automation Leads, Product, and Engineering teams for sprint training and fine-tuning.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Human-Assist QA Integration:</strong> Audit the handover from AI to Human-Assist to ensure context retention, CRM integration accuracy, and seamless agent workflow execution.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Benchmarking & Accuracy Scoring:</strong> Track and report on key QA metrics, including intent recognition accuracy, resolution precision, containment effectiveness, and compliance standards.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Data Validation & Testing:</strong> Conduct pre-release user acceptance testing (UAT) and regression testing for all new AI prompt deployments, KB updates, and workflow releases.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Defect & Gap Analysis:</strong> Partner with operational teams to identify recurring knowledge base gaps and out-of-scope customer queries to broaden AI coverage safely.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Qualifications & Experience </strong></p> <ul data-pm-slice="3 3 []"> <li> <p>QA or Process Improvement specialist with 2+ years of experience in customer contact-center operations or tech support environments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience in testing or auditing AI conversational flows, chatbots, virtual assistants, or automated workflow tooling.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) applied to quality control and operational auditing.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of AI behavior, intent structures, and natural language understanding (NLU) failure modes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven ability to translate operational customer friction into technical feedback for engineering and product teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated experience in data logging, audit reporting, and root-cause defect analysis.</p> </li> <li> <p>Customer-obsessed mindset with meticulous attention to detail and standard-setting for response quality.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills to bring to the role:  </strong></p> <ul data-pm-slice="3 3 []"> <li> <p><strong>Communication:</strong> Clear written and verbal reporting skills with the ability to articulate quality defects to technical and non-technical stakeholders <em>(required)</em>.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Analytical Mindset:</strong> Exceptional eye for detail with the ability to spot subtle pattern failures in data and conversational logs <em>(required)</em>.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Data Driven:</strong> Comfortable leveraging call/chat logs, accuracy metrics, and A/B test results to validate performance <em>(required)</em>.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Industry:</strong> Experience in a similar role within the Travel Industry <em>(Preferred)</em>.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses</li> <li>“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.</li> <li>Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.</li> <li>Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.</li> <li>Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.</li> <li>Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.</li> <li>Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.</li> <li>Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.</li> <li>Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.</li> <li>Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Cultural Pillars:</strong></p> <p><strong>Traveler first</strong></p> <p>We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. </p> <p><strong>Execution is our edge</strong></p> <p>We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges. </p> <p><strong>We succeed together</strong></p> <p>The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p>We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description: Material Bank is the world's largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials. Senior Analytics Engineer, Analytics & Insights London, UK (Hybrid, 2 days in office) Material Bank is the world's largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials. About the role We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join Analytics & Insights, the team that owns Material Bank's analytics data layer, internal reporting, and data products that support our teams and brand partners. This is a hands-on technical role for someone who wants to own how analytics get built. You will take approved metric definitions and business questions and turn them into the models and metric logic in Snowflake and dbt, the dashboards, and the semantic layer and data products people use every day. You will own the analytics engineering for key areas of the business: understanding what needs to be measured, building the models, validating the logic, delivering the reporting, and keeping it accurate and reliable over time. You will work across multiple departments and across our data products, including embedded analytics for brands. The work varies day to day, and as a team we contribute to everything. What we require Ownership, end to end. You own what you build, from the first stakeholder conversation to the model, the dashboard, and the fix when something breaks. Precision and attention to detail. You understand the nuance behind a number, verify before you publish, and produce work that leaders and brand partners can trust without checking. Appetite for hard work. We are a small, ambitious team with a lot of goals. The work is demanding and the hours vary with what needs to get done. We are upfront about that because it is what the role is. What you'll do Own the analytics engineering for assigned business domains, translating metric definition through data model, dashboard, and insight. Design, build, and maintain documented, production-quality dbt models in Snowflake that turn approved metric definitions into reliable, reusable models and semantic definitions, and power reporting, self-serve, automation, and AI. Identify and resolve technical inconsistencies in metric logic so the business runs on one certified source of truth. Build a small set of high-value dashboards in Tableau (and Sigma, as we evolve the stack). Contribute to the semantic layer so certified metrics are reusable across BI tools, Snowflake Cortex, and embedded analytics. Automate recurring analytics work, with the tests and monitoring that keep it trustworthy. Partner with analysts and stakeholders to interpret data, build context, and surface risks before they are asked. Contribute to brand-facing data products used by account teams and manufacturer partners. What you'll bring 5+ years in analytics engineering, data analytics, or a similar technical analytics role, owning data models and reporting that a business relies on. Expert SQL on large and complex datasets. You write clean, efficient queries and can debug someone else's logic as easily as your own. Strong hands-on Snowflake and dbt (or a comparable modern data stack), including dimensional modeling, incremental models, testing, and documentation. Strong Tableau skills. Sigma, Looker, or similar a plus. Strong judgment on metric design: grain, denominators, filters, time zones, deduplication, and the ways a correct number can still mislead. Commercial sense and curiosity. You want to understand why a number matters, can explain what a change means for the business, and hold a position under questioning. An automation mindset. When you see something repetitive or fragile, your instinct is to find a better way to build it. Comfort working across several domains at once, prioritizing your own work, and managing stakeholders directly. Clear, concise communication and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Preferred Helpful, not required: Python for automation and data validation Marketplace, e-commerce, or B2B SaaS analytics Event and behavioral data (Segment, GA4, or similar) Semantic layers and AI-assisted analytics (Snowflake Cortex, dbt Semantic Layer, or similar) Embedded or customer-facing analytics (ClickHouse, Preset, or similar) Experimentation and causal methods: A/B testing, cohort analysis, difference-in-differences Catalog, product attribute, or search data What success looks like In your first 30 days you understand the stack, the models, the people, and the priorities in your domains, and you have your first dbt change merged. By 60 days you are producing real work independently: agreed metric definitions implemented, your first certified models and dashboards in use, and a plan for the first manual workflow you will automate. By 90 days stakeholders treat you as their analytics partner rather than a request queue. Your models are trusted, your dashboards are used without hand-holding, and your automation is reducing real manual effort. This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad ownership and hands-on responsibility. Direct people management is not required. You will get to work alongside some of the brightest minds - Join a genuinely fun and supportive workplace where we keep our employees consistently engaged through internal communication and corporate events Relaxation and Celebrations : Generous PTO, Paid National Holidays, and even more (ask us about this when we connect). Health Benefits: We contribute to your medical healthcare rowth : We'll help you take your career to the next level. title: Regional Operations Director
description: Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. As a part of The Brandtech Group , we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. Role: Regional Operations Director (EMEA) Location: London, United Kingdom (3 days a week from our London offices) About the role: The Regional Operations Director is accountable for the operational effectiveness of the EMEA region. Reporting to the Global Chief Transformation and Operations Officer, you'll translate the global operating model into practical, market-specific execution — building the structure, governance and performance focus needed to strengthen operational control and support scalable growth. You'll lead a regional operations team, partner closely with regional and global leadership, and act as the key connector between regional execution and global capability. The role calls for a leader equally comfortable setting strategic direction and solving complex operational problems hands-on — someone who turns data into action, builds high-performing teams, and keeps commercial performance firmly in focus. Build the structure, rhythm and capability needed to improve client delivery, business performance and regional growth. Act as the senior operational partner to Regional Leadership on risks, performance, capacity and improvement priorities. Client delivery operations Own the operational run model for EMEA clients — including cadence, governance, issue resolution and escalation management. Partner with Account Leadership to ensure delivery risks are visible, blockers are resolved quickly and client teams are set up to deliver effectively. Ensure regional clients are mobilised and supported through consistent operating standards and reliable delivery controls. Governance, cadence and decision management Own the regional governance rhythm: forums, communications, decision-making and performance reviews. Ensure decisions are made at the right level, escalations are routed effectively and regional context is represented in relevant global and regional forums. Drive clear actions, accountability and follow-through across the function. Translate enterprise-level standards into practical, market-specific ways of working. Partner with Account Leadership and Finance to improve margin visibility and ensure practical actions are in place to protect profitable delivery. Oversee regional budget performance and present financial outcomes to regional and global stakeholders. Regional insight and continuous improvement Use performance data to identify risks, issues and improvement opportunities across the region. Translate insight into action — ensuring key issues have clear owners, measurable outcomes and appropriate escalation routes. Identify recurring operational bottlenecks and lead remediation, including regional adoption of global improvement initiatives. Cross-functional partnership Act as the key operational connector between EMEA and global operations capabilities. Provide regional operational input into sales pursuits, client mobilisation, scope expansions and solution design — ensuring proposed models are deliverable and scalable. Deep understanding of agency operating models — including client delivery, workflow, resource planning, utilisation, scopes of work, billing, compliance and margin management. Proven experience leading regional or multi-market operations teams in a people-led, fast-paced environment. Strong commercial acumen, with confidence managing the operational levers that affect profitability. Experience owning or improving resource and capacity management, including demand and supply visibility, workforce mix and deployment planning. Ability to use operational data, KPIs and reporting to identify risks, drive action and improve performance. Track record embedding governance, process discipline and ways of working across complex teams or markets. Strong cross-functional stakeholder skills — with experience partnering across regional and global functions including Finance, HR, Technology, Account and Delivery. Proven people leadership: building capable teams, strengthening operational performance and creating a culture of accountability. Comfortable moving between strategic direction and hands-on operational problem-solving. Desirable Experience in a global matrix organisation with regional, global and offshore delivery models. Background in an in-house agency, embedded agency, creative production or complex marketing ecosystem. Exposure to client mobilisation, implementation, transition or new operating model design. Experience contributing to RFPs, commercial modelling, solution design or delivery model development. Exposure to automation, AI-enabled operations, workflow optimisation or digital transformation in a marketing or agency environment. Commercial and budget accountability Experience overseeing regional or annual operational budgets and presenting financial performance to senior stakeholders. Track record of driving margin discipline — reducing leakage, rework and avoidable cost across complex delivery environments. Ability to connect operational decisions to commercial outcomes and communicate financial performance clearly to leadership. description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world: a complex, always-on, three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day. Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. The Team BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next , for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day. We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large. Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it. We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked. The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast. The Role Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office). This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer. You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier. Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams. What You'll Be Doing Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?" Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions. Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams. Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone. Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language. Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm. Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions. Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate brings strong expertise in some of these areas and the curiosity to grow in others: Experience in an analytical or data science role, such as data analytics, data science, forecasting, planning, strategy analytics, or a similar discipline. Experience in logistics, e-commerce, marketplaces, or another fast-moving, customer-focused business is useful but not essential. Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar. Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility. A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact. Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view. Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions. Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations. description: About Sona Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment. We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here . About the Role Sona's Labour AI team builds the forecasting, rules and scheduling tools that help hospitality and retail businesses get staffing right. Getting the tooling built is one problem. Getting it to actually work for a specific site, with its own trading patterns, staff and quirks, is another. That's what this role owns; working directly with customers to turn Sona's forecasting and scheduling tools into labour models that actually get used on site. You'll derive labour rules from real trading data, spend time on site with customer teams to learn how the business actually runs, and build the trust with site managers that makes a new workload model stick. You'll present the impact and ROI of that work to customer executives and general managers, and act as the subject matter expert for labour optimisation in sales conversations. You'll also be the person site managers trust enough to change how they staff, and the person customer executives and General Managers trust enough to back the changes you're proposing. That's an influence job as much as an analytical one. You'll report back to customer leadership on the impact, in numbers they can take to their own board. There's no fixed playbook here. title: Senior Product Manager (JetBrains Context)
description: <p>Coding agents are only as good as the context they're given. Most explore a repository like a new hire on day one – grepping, opening files, guessing. JetBrains Context replaces that with actual knowledge of your whole codebase and resources, served to any agent that asks. If you want to own the layer that decides what an agent knows before it writes a single line, this is for you.</p> <h2><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h2> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As agents get better at searching for themselves, what is the durable value of a managed retrieval layer? We need someone with an opinionated answer to own JetBrains Context as a product – defining what it is for, who it is for, how we measure success, and where it goes next.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role where you'll manage the product from a terminal and agent session rather than slides. You'll bridge the technical core and cross-functional teams: collaborating closely with engineering and ML teams on indexing pipelines and retrieval quality, working with Air, IDE, and Junie teams on integrations, and partnering with marketing, developer advocacy, sales, and customer success on positioning and adoption. You'll take full ownership of defining problem statements, setting explicit trade-offs, and balancing cost, latency, and freshness across the platform.</p> <p>Day to day, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain a deep working understanding of chunking, embeddings, index freshness, retrieval, reranking, and agent-facing surfaces.</li> <li>Define and defend an opinionated vision for the product's evolution, including explicit target audiences, use cases, and key success metrics.</li> <li>Translate product strategy into actionable problem statements, priorities, plans, and milestones with an explicit definition of “done”.</li> <li>Communicate product direction clearly to engineering, leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, customers, and prospects.</li> <li>Analyze competing context and code-search products through direct use to establish clear differentiators and identify gaps.</li> <li>Define core operational and product metrics – index freshness, retrieval quality, agent task outcomes, adoption, retention, and unit economics – to guide decision-making.</li> <li>Represent the product externally by sharing roadmaps, publishing updates, speaking to developer audiences, and gathering community feedback.</li> <li>Partner with ML teams on model evaluation and platform teams on service scale, reliability, and cost.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A well-argued point of view on where AI-first development is going and what agents genuinely need from a context layer.</li> <li>Comfort with technical depth across embeddings, retrieval quality, sub-agents, tool-calling, indexing costs, and API design.</li> <li>The habit of using the product you build daily alongside competitors' tools.</li> <li>Communication that adapts to different audiences, from staff engineers and enterprise architects to conference attendees.</li> <li>A data-informed approach that combines telemetry, evaluation results, customer conversations, and market signals.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and a preference for defining a new category over copying an existing one.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll need</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven experience owning a complex developer, platform, or infrastructure product end to end, including strategy and roadmap.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with modern AI coding tools and agent workflows.</li> <li>The technical capability to work directly with engineering on retrieval behavior, APIs, data models, and integration surfaces.</li> <li>The ability to define metrics for quality-sensitive products and build evaluation habits that maintain product standards.</li> <li>Experience communicating a product externally through written content, talks, or community engagement.</li> <li>Practical experience with search, retrieval, RAG, developer search, or static analysis at scale is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>Within your first months, you'll form and share a clear thesis for what JetBrains Context is and is not – one the engineering team recognizes as theirs and leadership can invest in. You'll establish a metrics story that distinguishes real retrieval quality from vanity usage, a roadmap with clear trade-offs, and a documented evaluation of serious competitors.</p> <p>Longer term, success means JetBrains Context becomes a deliberate choice for developers and organizations, agents get measurably better answers because it exists, enterprises adopt it for its governance and scale, and the market clearly understands its unique value because you've communicated it effectively.</p> <p><strong><br><br>Why join JetBrains? </strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.</li> <li>Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.</li> <li>Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.</li> <li>Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.</li> <li>Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family</li> <li>Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.</li> <li>Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.</li> <li>Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.</li> <li>Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.</li> <li>Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.</li> <li>Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.</li> </ul> <p>*Some benefits may vary depending on location.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-HYBRID - if you <strong>want</strong> LinkedIn to post your role as hybrid in all the locations where the role is open ---> leave this tag in JD</span><br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-AA1 </span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the <a href="https://www.jetbrains.com/legal/docs/privacy/privacy-recruitment/">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a></em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager, Subscriptions
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Senior Product Manager<br>London, UK (Hybrid) </span></strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Role Overview</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"335557856":16777215,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">As a </span><strong><span data-contrast="none">Senior Product Manager </span></strong><span data-contrast="none">you will work within the Commerce Platform area of the PlayStation business, leading initiatives that drive monetization growth for PlayStation’s membership program, PlayStation Plus, in addition to commerce experiences for players.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335557856":16777215,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">You will expand upon the PlayStation Plus service to evolve the value proposition and support business goals to acquire new audiences and expand PlayStation’s reach. title: Director, International Communications
description: <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>MKTQ427R39</strong></p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>Databricks is hiring a Director of International Communications to build and scale our global communications strategy. As Databricks grows its footprint, this role will own how that story gets told: new market entries, in-country investments, new offices, customer wins, and local business milestones that build Databricks' reputation market by market. This role will serve as a strategic communications advisor to regional and country leaders in Europe, Asia, and the Americas and will be responsible for the execution of communications programs across those regions. This is a strategic role: turning business momentum into locally resonant news that establishes Databricks as a leader in data and AI around the world.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What This Role Unlocks</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Communications advisor to regional leaders – </strong>advise on PR, social, internal comms strategy</li> <li><strong>Regional news at scale</strong> — a dedicated strategy for translating business growth across Europe, Asia, and the Americas into press moments.</li> <li><strong>Local relevance, global consistency</strong> — an approach tailored to each region's media landscape while staying true to Databricks' global product and corporate narrative.</li> <li><strong>Strong in-market presence</strong> — deep relationships with regional leadership, agencies, and field teams.</li> <li><strong>Leadership for regional PR teams</strong> — a dedicated manager and mentor for our international communications leads while building close relationships with U.S. based comms and product leaders.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Impact You Will Have</strong></p> <p><strong>Regional Communications Strategy</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own Databricks' international communications strategy across three regions: Europe, Asia, and the Americas (13 countries).</li> <li>Spot and drive market-specific news — expansions, investments, new offices, customer milestones, and partnerships — that builds Databricks' profile in each country.</li> <li>Evolve the communications strategy as the business scales into new and existing regions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Regional Partnership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the connective tissue between global communications strategy and on-the-ground business momentum in every region.</li> <li>Partner with regional business leaders, ensuring strategy reflects local business priorities.</li> <li>Partner with field marketing and country managers to identify stories worth telling on the ground</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Leadership & Agency/Media Relationships</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage and support Databricks' communications leads internationally; set clear direction and priorities while providing the autonomy to run their markets.</li> <li>Manage PR agency relationships across all 13 covered markets.</li> <li>Build direct relationships with key regional media so each market has the storytelling support it needs to land Databricks' news locally.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What We Look For</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years of experience in international, regional, or global communications, ideally in enterprise software, cloud, or AI.</li> <li>Proven track record building regional press strategies and driving coverage across multiple international markets.</li> <li>Strong people management experience, with a track record of developing communications professionals across international teams.</li> <li>Experience managing PR agencies across diverse regions and media landscapes.</li> <li>Strong relationship-building skills with senior business leaders and field teams.</li> <li>Sharp news judgment — able to spot and shape a story from business developments like market entries, customer wins, or new offices.</li> <li>Comfort operating across time zones and cultures, balancing global consistency with local relevance.</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally as needed.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. title: Senior Social Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3054 - Snr MAI Paid Social Manager - GCS</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>Wavemaker Worldwide Activation is the digital specialist arm of the worldwide hub. It powers the digital thinking for Wavemakers largest global clients and acts as a central planning and buying team for clients who buy multimarket digital campaigns from one location. Our digital thinking brings together media, data and technology to drive business results for our clients and is directly connected to our most senior global management team offering increased opportunity for senior level exposure.</p> <p><strong>Client Context:</strong></p> <p>Audible is Wavemaker Worldwide’s largest client and one of the world’s favourite platforms for audio content, from podcasts to audio books to Audible Originals. Audible have ambitious growth targets that we will help them achieve through both branding and performance campaigns across four major markets: France, Italy, Germany and Spain giving the applicate an opportunity to work across market and understand how different markets behaviour and respond to media.</p> <p><strong>Role Context:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a specialist in paid social app/MAI campaigns to continue their career as Account Manager. This person will play an integral role in the day-to-day running of a busy client account. They will be required to work with the line manager to help oversee more junior team members with the overall aim of delivering flawless paid social campaigns for clients. The ideal candidate is someone with good working knowledge of paid advertising across one or more of the key social channels (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snap, TikTok etc). The candidate should also have in-depth experience of working with mobile app-install campaigns across Meta, Reddit, Twitter, TikTok and Snapchat and also be proficient in understanding the specific challenges of mobile/app campaign tracking including having worked with MMPs. This person will also be required to develop relationships with clients, suppliers, and other stakeholders becoming a trusted voice for all things paid social.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p>Account Managers are expected to work closely with their Account Director and the Global Hub team to manage the day-to-day running of one (or more) client accounts. Account Managers have several key areas of focus, these include:</p> <p><strong>Campaign Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Developing comprehensive paid social media plans (+ supporting material) that align with client’s objectives and KPIs focussing on mobile app-install campaigns. Able to clearly articulate the rationale for proposed campaign tactics (channels, budget, audience, formats etc.) and present these back, both to internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Responsible for end-to-end set up of paid social campaigns across all the relevant social platforms (and working with junior team members to assist them with this task as necessary), focusing on app-install campaigns. Comfortable using advanced features such as bid rules and 3rd party optimisation/ creative/ measurement tools to achieve results for clients.</li> <li>Responsible for ensuring regular quality assurance (QA) checks are undertaken by everyone working on the account (both locally and in the Global Hub team) to ensure campaigns are set up to defined best practice standards.</li> <li>Responsible for monitoring campaign performance and pacing to ensure all activity delivers as expected. Troubleshooting and optimising campaigns in order to improve performance as necessary.</li> <li>Working with Executives, Snr. Executives and the Global Hub team to produce detailed & accurate weekly/monthly campaign performance reports, often in Microsoft Excel. Leading client calls to present results as necessary.</li> <li>Writing performance commentary that delivers valuable insight and recommendations to clients. Should be able to identify trends and recommend actions on-platform to capitalise/mitigate these trends as necessary. Working with junior team members to ensure standards for commentary remain consistent.</li> <li>Producing more detailed analysis including end-of-campaign reporting, quarterly/annual reviews, and for standalone projects.</li> <li>Owning the tracking of app-install campaigns across social activity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client & Partner Management </strong></p> <ul> <li>Acting as a key social point-of-contact for your client(s) ensuring their continuing confidence in the quality of the team and agency’s social output.</li> <li>Demonstrating a deep understanding of the media and technology developments that influence your client’s business. Able to identify opportunities to test and innovate in the paid social space, presenting these opportunities to stakeholders and securing client backing.</li> <li>Building and maintaining relationships with the key media partners including Meta, Twitter, Snap, TikTok, Pinterest and others.</li> </ul> <p><strong>People Management </strong></p> <ul> <li>Working with your line-manager to ensure the effective management of more junior team members ensuring workloads are sufficiently monitored & prioritised to ensure deadlines are met.</li> <li>Able to communicate clearly and in a timely manner with internal and external stakeholders as required across email, chat, video and in-person. Leading presentations where necessary.</li> <li>Attend regular internal meetings and training sessions in order to actively contribute to a collaborative and friendly paid social community. Leading by example to motivate and encourage those with less experience.</li> <li>Assisting with the recruitment process for the immediate and wider team. Attending interviews and acting as an ambassador for the team to potential candidates.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify opportunities to test and innovate in the paid social space. Presenting these opportunities to stakeholders and securing client backing.</li> <li>Working with line-manager to develop and implement testing/learning agendas for clients that drive clear and actionable insight on each social platform.</li> <li>Working closely with planning team + other channel specialists to ensure paid social activity compliments and enhances the wider marketing mix.</li> <li>Responsible for accurate and timely fulfilment of mandatory agency finance processes. Working with junior team members and the Global Hub team to ensure processes are followed, allowing for prompt payment/invoicing and to minimise finance queries.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a candidate who can display the following attributes:</p> <ul> <li>The successful candidate should have experience working in a digital marketing or agency-based role and will need to demonstrate a track record of working with clients or external stakeholders.</li> <li>Extensive experience setting up and optimising paid social campaigns across a number of the key social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snap, TikTok etc). Training certifications in any of the key platforms would be a plus (e.g. Meta Blueprint).</li> <li>Experience planning large-scale paid social campaigns including app-install campaigns with performance objectives.</li> <li>Experience working with mobile measurement platforms (such as Kochava or Appsflyer) and accompanying data-sets.</li> <li>Experience compiling detailed and insightful end of campaign reports & presentations. Knowledge of how to structure regular client review presentations (QBRs, annual reviews etc).</li> <li>Forming strong relationships is key to the role, the ideal candidate should feel comfortable presenting to clients and leading calls as required.</li> <li>Teamwork is key to this role and we are looking for someone who is collaborative, friendly, and with a can-do attitude.</li> <li>Some experience line managing individuals and/or helping to train others across paid social would be preferable.</li> <li>In return the successful candidate can expect to work as a member of a fun and engaging team that is part of a company that truly champions learning, development and will invest in your career over the long term.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Life at WPP Media & Benefits</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Championing Growth and Development</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Create an Open environment</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}">

title: Senior Associate, Clients, GCS
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3401 - Senior Associate, Clients, GCS</strong></p> <p><strong>ABOUT WPP & OPENDOOR</strong></p> <p>At WPP, we’re constantly reinventing the future of creativity on an ever-broader canvas, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and skills to provide an integrated offer of communications, experience, commerce and technology.</p> <p>Over the last decade, we have developed a dedicated global client practice with the mission of accelerating WPP’s impact for our largest clients by bringing them the best of WPP. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built <strong>OpenDoor </strong>for<strong> Amazon</strong>.</p> <p><strong>OpenDoor</strong> is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive <em>impact</em> – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The OpenDoor partnership model is designed to deliver next-level productivity through an industry-leading approach to people, platforms and processes. OpenDoor brings together WPP agencies and disciplines including media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, technology and commerce, public relations and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values draw on Amazon’s <a href="https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/our-workplace/leadership-principles"><strong>16 Leadership Principles</strong></a> and WPP’s values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, WPP’s creative transformation and Amazon’s customer focus empower our people to challenge today’s conventions and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, you will become part of a cross-functional team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients. You will work in new ways on ambitious opportunities across marketing, technology, media, business and creativity.</p> <p>ABOUT THE ROLE</p> <p>We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our OpenDoor team as a Client Senior Executive. This full-time, London-based role reports to the Regional Client Associate Director and supports XCM, Amazon’s Cross-Channel Marketing division. The position sits within a regional team that works remotely across the UK and Germany, with the line manager based in DE and regular collaboration with colleagues and local market teams across Europe. The Client Senior Executive coordinates campaigns and workstreams from briefing to delivery, helping to ensure consistent client service, robust operations and high-quality execution.</p> <p>XCM is Amazon’s Cross-Channel Marketing division, delivering communications for Amazon.com, including major campaigns such as Black Friday and Prime Day. OpenDoor is XCM’s media partner worldwide, excluding North America and Latin America. As Europe is the largest region supported by the WPP team, the Regional XCM Client Senior Executive plays an important role in coordinating consistent delivery across markets.</p> <p>RESPONSIBILITIES</p> <p>Collaboration across OpenDoor and the wider WPP network is central to the role, with a strong focus on best practice, operational consistency and on-time delivery.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Campaign delivery and coordination:</strong> Coordinate regional XCM campaigns and workstreams from briefing to delivery, tracking milestones, dependencies, risks and actions across client, internal and local market teams.</li> <li><strong>Client service and communication:</strong> Act as a professional point of contact for client enquiries and requests, providing clear updates on campaign progress, deliverables and performance.</li> <li><strong>Regional planning and reporting:</strong> Coordinate the accurate and timely delivery of regional plans and reports, including weekly spend trackers, performance reports and campaign status updates.</li> <li><strong>Operational setup and governance:</strong> Set up and maintain reporting templates, trackers, campaign documentation and ways of working; coordinate inputs, complete quality checks and support consistent data and processes across markets.</li> <li><strong>Finance and billing:</strong> Support finance processes by collating purchase orders, maintaining budget trackers, monitoring client billing, and escalating discrepancies or missing information.</li> <li><strong>Meetings and follow-up:</strong> Participate in and facilitate regular client, internal and creative agency meetings, preparing agendas and materials and documenting actions, owners and deadlines.</li> <li>Communicate Global Campaign guidelines to local market teams, clarify requirements and support consistent implementation across markets.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with regional departments, local OpenDoor teams and wider WPP partners, working effectively across locations and time zones.</li> <li>Develop a strong understanding of Amazon’s ways of working and the OpenDoor operating model to improve organisation, quality and consistency.</li> <li>Identify and share best-in-class work from across the network, helping regional clients and local markets adopt effective approaches.</li> <li>Contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment and work with the line manager to set objectives aligned with the role and agency vision.</li> </ul> <p>QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE</p> <ul> <li>2–3 years’ experience in media planning, client management or account coordination, preferably within a network agency.</li> <li>Excellent organisational and project planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset, with close attention to detail.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders and collaborate effectively.</li> <li>Awareness of the media and marketing industry, including key channels, emerging trends and planning principles.</li> <li>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic and geographically distributed working environment.</li> <li>Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.</li> <li>Ability to manage defined tasks independently and present outputs directly to clients or package them clearly for the wider team.</li> </ul> <p>BONUS POINTS</p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting multi-market or regional accounts.</li> <li>Experience with campaign reporting, budget tracking, operational governance or workflow tools.</li> <li>Familiarity with Amazon’s ecosystem, ways of working and Leadership Principles.</li> <li>Understanding of cross-channel media planning and how individual channels contribute to an integrated plan.</li> </ul> <p>BENEFITS OF OPENDOOR</p> <ul> <li><strong>Unparalleled Access:</strong> Gain direct experience working with one of the world’s most innovative and influential companies.</li> <li><strong>Mentoring and Training:</strong> Receive guidance from experienced professionals at both WPP and Amazon.</li> <li><strong>Cutting-Edge Technology:</strong> Utilise industry-leading tools and platforms, including WPP Open.</li> title: Performance Marketing Manager
description: About Bike Club We're customer obsessed. We put the customer at the heart of everything we do - and we're looking for people who feel the same way. Bike Club is changing the way families access children's bikes. Through our subscription model, we make it easy for families to get the right bike at the right time, while keeping bikes in circulation for longer. We are a purpose-led, fast-growing business with a strong focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling. The Role We are looking for a commercially driven Performance Marketing Manager to manage and improve customer acquisition across the UK and Germany. Reporting to the Marketing Director, you will be responsible for the management of the performance marketing agency and overall delivery of our paid acquisition strategy. You will manage our agency partners, monitor channel performance and use customer and commercial data to recommend where we should invest, test and optimise. This role combines performance marketing expertise with strong commercial judgement. You will work closely with Marketing, Content, Data, Product, Finance and Commercial colleagues to improve the efficiency, quality and predictability of customer acquisition. You will be comfortable moving between strategic planning and detailed performance analysis, challenging agency recommendations and turning data into clear actions. Tasks What You'll Do - Acquisition Planning Develop and deliver Bike Club's customer acquisition plans across the UK and Germany in collaboration with the Marketing Director. Translate business objectives into channel plans, campaign targets and testing priorities. Recommend how acquisition budgets should be allocated across markets, channels and campaigns. Identify new opportunities to grow customer acquisition and market penetration. Develop a clear test-and-learn roadmap across channels, audiences, propositions, creative, and landing pages. Continuously assess the effectiveness and scalability of acquisition channels**.** - Performance Marketing Manage our performance marketing agency and other acquisition partners ensuring they deliver against agreed objectives. Oversee the day-to-day performance and optimisation of paid acquisition activity across relevant channels. Lead the restructure of paid search around parent needs and intent (sizing, outgrown bikes, exchange) rather than subscription terms. Review campaign plans, media spend, targeting, creative and results, constructively challenging agency recommendations where appropriate. Track customer acquisition cost, conversion, return on advertising spend and other key measures of performance. Focus acquisition activity on acquiring high-quality, sustainable customers rather than simply driving volume. Work closely with the content team to develop strong campaign propositions, briefs and creative testing plans. Identify opportunities to improve landing pages and customer journeys. Ensure learning from campaigns and tests is documented and applied to future activity. - Commercial Performance & Data Own day-to-day reporting on acquisition KPIs, including CAC, conversion, ROAS, payback and customer value. Partner closely with Finance and Data to understand acquisition economics and profitability. Analyse performance by channel, audience, campaign, proposition and market. Develop robust forecasting and scenario planning for acquisition performance for the Marketing Director and wider business Ensure performance data is accurate, accessible and used consistently in decision-making. Present findings and recommendations clearly to both marketing specialists and wider business stakeholders. Requirements About You You'll be an experienced performance marketer who combines channel knowledge with strong commercial and analytical judgement. You'll bring: Relevant experience in performance marketing, customer acquisition or growth marketing within a consumer-focused business or agency. A strong understanding of paid acquisition channels and how they work together within the customer journey. Experience managing performance marketing agencies or external partners. A track record of improving acquisition performance while maintaining commercial discipline. Strong analytical and commercial skills, with the ability to translate data into practical recommendations. Experience developing and evaluating campaign tests across audiences, creative, propositions or channels. Experience managing a multi-channel, multi-market budget of £1m+, including making investment recommendations A test-and-learn mindset and genuine curiosity about what drives customer behaviour. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Experience working across multiple markets, ideally including Germany is desirable. What Success Looks Like In your first 12 months, you will have: Delivered the acquisition plan in the UK and Germany hitting targets and establishing ways of working for future growth. Improved the efficiency and predictability of customer acquisition. Established clear acquisition KPIs and reporting. Built an effective and accountable relationship with our performance marketing agency. Developed a structured programme of testing across channels, audiences, propositions and creative. Identified and scaled the strongest acquisition opportunities. Improved collaboration between Marketing, Data, Product, Finance and Commercial teams. Benefits 🌴We offer 26 days per year + bank holidays 💷Pension salary sacrifice 🏡Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave 🚴Employee Discount on our bikes Why BikeClub? You'll be joining a business with a clear purpose, a genuinely different proposition and significant opportunity to grow. This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the next stage of Bike Club's growth, while helping build a more sustainable way for families to access children's bikes. title: Financial Accountant (12 month FTC)
description: WHO WE ARE Trustly is leading the human centric payments revolution. To us, this means passionately building the most convenient, intelligent and responsible way of paying for things online. Whether it's for shopping, paying subscriptions, funding trading accounts, booking airfare, playing online games and much more, we're all about a better way to pay. At our core, we are a tech company with industry leading tech capabilities. But it's the ingenuity of our people that makes us leaders in our field. Thus, our appetite for innovation will never be anything less than fierce. Trustly is steadily growing as it connects thousands of businesses with hundreds of millions of people. And with a strong presence across Europe and the Americas, we are leading the human centric payment revolution as a truly global team. This role is in the Financial Reporting and Accounting team, part of the Group Internal Finance team at Trustly, which also comprises Tax, Treasury, Payroll, Finance Operations and Finance Systems. The team has an ethos of collaboration and continued improvement at its heart. From credit cards and personal loans to new lending products, we’re building simple, transparent ways for customers to borrow with confidence.</p> <p>You’ll join a highly collaborative team where Credit works closely with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Finance and Risk. We move quickly, test ideas, learn from data and continuously improve the experience for our customers.</p> <p>From day one, you'll be part of the team. You'll own meaningful work, solve real problems with data and help ship improvements that make borrowing better for our customers.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🚀 The scheme</strong></p> <p>Over two years you’ll complete three eight-month rotations, giving you broad exposure to how modern credit works while helping you discover where your strengths lie.</p> <p>Along the way, you'll build technical skills, learn from experienced mentors and work on projects that have real business and customer impact. You'll see your work make it into production, helping shape the lending products our customers use.</p> <p>Depending on your rotations, you could work  in areas such as:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Credit Strategy</strong> - Help answer some of our biggest questions, like who we lend to, how much we lend, and how we can help more customers access credit responsibly. You'll use data, experimentation and commercial thinking to turn those answers into action.</li> <li><strong>Machine Learning</strong> - Help develop and improve the models that power our lending decisions, using machine learning and statistical techniques to create better outcomes for our customers.</li> <li><strong>Regulatory Modelling</strong> - Build and maintain the models which help us understand future credit losses, manage capital and support Monzo’s continued growth.</li> <li><strong>Credit Risk Assurance</strong> - Provide independent review and challenge of lending strategies and models, helping ensure our decisions remain robust, well-governed and customer-focused.</li> </ul> <p>The programme is just the start. By the end of your rotations, you'll have the skills and experience to continue growing your career across Borrowing at Monzo.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You graduated in 2026 or are graduating in 2027 with, or expecting to achieve, at least a 2:1 in a STEM, Economics or another highly analytical degree. We welcome applications from graduates of all levels including Masters and PhD.</li> <li>You enjoy solving complex problems using data</li> <li>You're curious, collaborative and excited to learn new technologies</li> <li>You enjoy asking questions, digging into data and finding better ways to solve problems</li> <li>You want to build products that genuinely improve customers' financial lives</li> <li>You must have the permanent right to work in the UK, as we're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role now or in the future</li> <li>You're able to work from our London office three days per week on a hybrid basis</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £50,000 base salary + incentive award tied to your performance</p> <p>📍 This role will be based in our London office on a hybrid basis (3 days per week in the office)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>🎓 Training courses on programming languages like SQL & Python, alongside behavioural skills like effective communication and presenting data analysis.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, additional training courses and conferences.</p> <p>💻 Top-spec Macbook and accessories to use over the course of your time with us</p> <p>🧠 Knowledge-sharing sessions with your squad and wider discipline</p> <p>👯 Team and company wide socials / events</p> <p>🍝 Lunch on Monzo twice a week from a range of street food vendors</p> <p>➕ And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Submit your application and answer a few short questions</li> <li>Complete an online exercise to showcase your analytical thinking and problem-solving skills (this will be sent out to eligible candidates once applications close) </li> <li>Join us for an in-person assessment centre (<strong>23rd November 2026</strong>). You'll meet people from across the team, take part in a series of interviews and learn more about what it's like to work at Monzo.</li> </ol> <p>Applications close at <strong>18:00</strong> <strong>PM on 27 September 2026</strong> but we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here</a>.<br>#LI-JH1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

It’s how our customers move, receive, spend and manage their money, from cards and bank transfers to cross-border payments, merchant acquiring, payment experiences in the app, and the platform infrastructure that underpins the whole bank.</p> <p>This role sits in our Payments Platform area, working most closely with our Finance Infrastructure squad. The squad sits in Payments, but partners deeply with Finance teams to build the systems, abstractions and capabilities Monzo needs to operate safely, scale efficiently, and expand into new markets. You’ll work on foundational financial infrastructure: the ledgers, data, controls, reporting, reconciliation and platform capabilities that help Monzo understand, account for and manage money across the bank.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited by complex, technical infrastructure. The work is often behind the scenes, but it’s business-critical: it helps Monzo scale, launch new products and markets, support Finance, and keep the bank running safely.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</h4> <ul> <li>Defining the product strategy and roadmap for Finance Infrastructure within Payments Platform.</li> <li>Partnering closely with Engineering, Finance and Payments leaders to understand what Monzo needs from its financial systems today and as we scale.</li> <li>Moving the team from reactive delivery towards a more strategic, product-led approach, asking why we’re building things, what good looks like, and how today’s choices support Monzo’s long-term needs.</li> <li>Translating complex finance, accounting, operational and regulatory needs into scalable platform capabilities.</li> <li>Prioritising across competing stakeholder needs, balancing urgent delivery with long-term system health.</li> <li>Helping Monzo build financial infrastructure that can support multiple products, entities, countries, currencies and regulatory environments.</li> <li>Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Product and Operations.</li> <li>Bringing strong product discipline, technical curiosity and systems thinking to a space that is critical to Monzo’s future growth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</h4> <ul> <li>You’re a strong senior Product Manager with experience owning complex technical, platform, infrastructure or financial systems.</li> <li>You have enough technical depth to partner credibly with engineers and reason about systems, trade-offs, dependencies and long-term architecture.</li> <li>You’re excited by “boring but critical” infrastructure, things like ledgers, reconciliation, financial data, controls, reporting, internal platforms, abstractions or backend systems.</li> <li>You can work with senior and cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Engineering, Product and operational teams.</li> <li>You’re comfortable bringing product thinking into ambiguous or stakeholder-heavy environments, and moving teams from request-led delivery towards long-term strategy.</li> <li>You’re high-agency, ambitious and excited to stretch yourself in a team with a high bar.</li> <li>You care about customers and business outcomes, even when the work is several layers removed from the end customer experience.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p> </p> <h4>🙌 What’s in it for you</h4> <p>💰 £125,000 - £145,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ equity</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa. </p> <p>📍This role is hybrid working from our London office</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</h4> <ul> <li>First stage - Meet with our Collective Product Director</li> <li>Second stage - Meet with our Engineering and Finance leadership</li> <li>Third stage - Product full loop</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. You will lead the workstreams and build agents to transform how we produce content at scale, while supporting the adoption of AI applications more broadly across the business. This means driving a rigorous selection process from requirements through vendor evaluation to a clear, well-justified recommendation.</p> <p><strong>AI adoption across the business:</strong> Championing the adoption of AI-driven solutions beyond the programme, including helping other teams understand and apply AI, and sharing what works.</p> <p><strong>This is for you if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of building and applying AI for teams.
