You will work in a team that manages the P&L and Balance Sheet to deliver the financial plan, helps the business to make strategic financial decisions, challenges to improve performance, and owns the end-to-end financials and financial controls for your business area. </p> <p>The right candidate will enjoy supporting and challenging the business across new initiatives, love to build business cases, present and debate investment choices and be comfortable with both digging into data to deliver insights and thinking about broader strategic choices.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Being the single point of contact between the business and finance - you will have an opportunity to work senior leaders in driving commercial projects, analysing performance of existing products and participating in day to day support of the business.</li> <li>Diving deep into the data - looking for trends, opportunities and stories that can be used in improving our profitability and growth. We're open to distributed working within the UK, with the expectation of at least once a week in our London office.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 4 key steps:<br><br></strong><strong>- Phone call with recruiter (30mins)<br></strong><strong>- Video call with finance team member (30 mins)<br></strong><strong>- Video call with hiring manager (45 min)<br></strong><strong>- Video call with stakeholder (30 mins)</strong></p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. The team is responsible for understanding our prudential regulatory reporting requirements, working on projects and submissions relating to these and collaborating with teams across Monzo.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Taking ownership of the preparation, analysis and submission of regulatory reporting requirements (e.g. Capital, Liquidity)</li> <li>Ensuring compliance with the applicable regulatory interpretations</li> <li>Assisting the wider team in producing Monzo’s capital and liquidity regulatory reporting and disclosures (including Pillar 3)</li> <li>Executing and improving the controls required to ensure regulatory reporting is timely, accurate and complete</li> <li>Ensuring high data quality by performing data profiling and investigating data quality issues</li> <li>Using data visualisation tools to build dashboards and facilitate sign-off and useful insights</li> <li>Partnering with teams internally to help them make informed business decisions and providing input into new product launches</li> <li>Designing brilliant ways to automate your work and leverage technology to ensure we scale with the business</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩We’d love to hear from you if…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a good understanding of capital requirements, liquidity reports and regulatory frameworks</li> <li>You’re excited by data and have a sharp eye for detail</li> <li>You have knowledge of coding languages (SQL would be a bonus), although a willingness to learn is just fine </li> <li>You have strong analytical skills, high attention to detail and the ability to meet tight deadlines</li> <li>You want to automate or enhance recurring processes, particularly by leveraging technology, and implement changes in collaboration with IT and regulatory change teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £56,100 - £64,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office, with a hybrid working approach</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 4 key steps:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Phone call with recruiter</li> <li>Initial call with hiring manager (30 mins)</li> <li>Technical interview with hiring manager and team member (45 mins)</li> <li>Monzo behavioural interview (45 min)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3 - 4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! <br><br>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo 🤖 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-NZ1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. With Myprotein's slogan, <em data-start="420" data-end="440">Fuel your ambition</em>, at the heart of everything we do, we’re on a mission to be the world's most empowering health movement, championing everyone to live healthier, more active lives. Our brands and people exist to break boundaries, to power and empower those who want more.</p> <p data-start="143" data-end="197"><strong data-start="143" data-end="197">Why be a Senior Influencer Executive for Germany Myprotein?</strong></p> <p data-start="199" data-end="877">At Myprotein, we’re more than just a sports nutrition brand, we’re a global movement driven by passion, innovation and our mission to <em data-start="346" data-end="366">Fuel your ambition</em>. As Senior Influencer Executive for Germany, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the way our brand connects with an influential and growing fitness community. You’ll work alongside a passionate, high-performing marketing team and play a pivotal role in scaling our influencer strategy in one of our fastest-growing markets. This is a unique chance to blend creativity, strategic thinking, and cultural insight, all while working with some of the most exciting talent in the German fitness and wellbeing space.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities include:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-start="191" data-end="408">Own and drive the day-to-day operations of the German influencer programme, ensuring consistent growth and performance, while maintaining strong working relationships with creators and talent agents in the region.</li> <li data-start="412" data-end="587">Support the Senior Influencer Manager – EU in shaping and executing the German influencer strategy, aligning with overall EU and global objectives for the Myprotein brand.</li> <li data-start="591" data-end="815">Deliver detailed performance reporting on a weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly basis, analysing key KPIs including engagement, reach, conversions and ROI, and presenting insights and recommendations to internal stakeholders.</li> <li data-start="819" data-end="999">Manage programme maintenance, ensuring influencer tracking links, discount codes, and promotional offers are accurate, live, and performing optimally across all communications.</li> <li data-start="1003" data-end="1238">Actively source and recruit new German influencer talent, with a focus on brand alignment, commercial potential, and cultural fit – from micro creators to emerging macro talent – to support customer acquisition and brand awareness.</li> <li data-start="1242" data-end="1466">Collaborate cross-functionally with key stakeholders including content, brand, commercial, paid media and product marketing teams to plan, brief, and execute integrated influencer campaigns tailored to the German market.</li> <li data-start="1470" data-end="1636">Own the full campaign process for German influencer activations – from planning and briefing, to execution, approvals, content collection, analysis and learnings.</li> <li data-start="1640" data-end="1828">Ensure influencer content is on-brand, high quality and aligned with current German social media trends, fitness culture and seasonal campaigns, maintaining relevance and authenticity.</li> <li data-start="1832" data-end="2028">Lead on German influencer payments and budget tracking, ensuring accurate and timely invoicing and monthly purchase order (PO) processes are completed in line with internal finance procedures.</li> <li data-start="2032" data-end="2256">Encourage collaboration across influencer tiers, nurturing an engaged community through creative activations, collaborative content opportunities and connections with wider marketing channels (e.g., events, social, CRM).</li> <li data-start="2260" data-end="2416">Support brand-led events, campaigns and content creation, ensuring German influencer presence and involvement is maximised to generate impact and reach.</li> <li data-start="2420" data-end="2610">Stay ahead of industry trends in Germany , identifying emerging platforms, content formats, and creator trends to future-proof Myprotein’s influencer approach and maintain brand relevance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We're looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Native level German language skills both written and spoken</li> <li>Business level English language skills both written and spoken</li> <li>Degree Qualified (Preferred)</li> <li>2+ year experience in Influencer marketing (preferred)</li> <li>A genuine interest in health, wellbeing, fitness and an ambition to be at the forefront of German influencer marketing</li> <li>An understanding of how influencers can play a key role in building brand awareness, affinity, content creation and driving commercial value for brands</li> <li>Deep knowledge of current and emerging German social media platforms including but not limited to Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok etc.</li> <li>Outstanding communication, negotiation and organisational skills</li> <li>A proactive self-starter with a problem-solving attitude and the ability to meet deadlines</li> <li>Knowledge of the German fitness industry and social media trends</li> </ul> title: Head of Data Engineering & Governance
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG. </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p></div><p><strong>Location: Icon 1, WA15 0AF</strong></p> <p><strong>About Central Functions</strong></p> <p>Central Functions is formed of the teams and people that serve the entire business. These people are integral to the smooth running of the business; ensuring everyone is paid on time, that materials are sourced and arrive promptly, that we meet our legal obligations and that our health, safety, and security is safeguarded.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be the Head of Data Engineering and Governance at THG?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p>THG is building a world-class data function to power one of the UK's largest e-commerce businesses. As Head of Engineering & Governance, you will own the quality, availability and structure of the data that enables every business-facing team across our Beauty and Nutrition divisions.</p> <p>This is not a systems infrastructure role. You are not managing foundational platform plumbing — that sits with our technology partner, Ingenuity. Your remit is the layer above that: how data is structured, governed, made available and used across the business. You will set the direction for how THG gets the most from its data ecosystem, ensuring that analytics teams, data scientists, and business leaders can trust and act on the data they see.</p> <p>You will lead three distinct functions: Engineering (how we build, structure and maintain our data domains), Governance (how we ensure quality, consistency and trust), and Reporting (how we present business performance data consistently across PLC). You will work closely with Ingenuity, who provide the foundational platform and first-layer pipelines, to set requirements and standards that flow through from ingestion to insight.</p> <p>We are at an early stage of this journey. Our data foundations need significant work — we have talented analysts who have been doing engineering work without the structure or tools to do it well, governance that is essentially non-existent, and reporting that has grown organically without consistency. You will shape and deliver the roadmap that fixes this.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Strategic Direction</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the vision and roadmap for data engineering, governance and reporting across THG PLC</li> <li>Define how data domains (Customer, Commercial, Operations) should be structured, stored and made available for analytics, data science and AI use cases</li> <li>Own the relationship with Ingenuity on platform and data matters — setting requirements, managing dependencies and ensuring PLC needs are reflected in the Ingen roadmap</li> <li>Evaluate where THG should use Ingen capability versus external tooling, and ensure every technology choice is documented and commercially justified</li> <li>Drive the business towards a single source of truth — reducing data silos, resolving mastering conflicts, and building confidence in our data across the organisation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Engineering & Data Platform</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the Engineering team in building and maintaining the data pipelines, domain datasets and platform architecture that underpin analytics across Beauty and Nutrition</li> <li>Own the evolution of our GCP/BigQuery platform — from how data is ingested and stored, to how it is structured for downstream consumption</li> <li>Set engineering standards — version control, testing, error handling, documentation — and ensure they are consistently applied</li> <li>Champion the use of AI and automation in data engineering — this is a small team that needs to move fast, and we expect the use of AI-assisted pipeline development and management to be embedded in how we work</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the Data Governance function from a standing start — we have no established governance framework and this is a greenfield opportunity to build it properly</li> <li>Own the framework for how THG manages data quality, metadata, data definitions and lineage across PLC</li> <li>Work with Ingenuity to ensure governance standards are consistent across both PLC and Ingen data infrastructure</li> <li>Build the culture and processes that make governance a positive enabler rather than a compliance burden</li> </ul> <p><strong>Reporting & BI</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the consistency and quality of all business performance reporting across THG PLC — dashboards, KPI reports, executive-level views</li> <li>Ensure that any regularly used report or dashboard is owned, maintained and built to a consistent standard — no more ad hoc reporting that lives outside a managed framework</li> <li>Lead the evolution of our Tableau estate and assess when alternative or complementary tooling should be introduced</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership & People</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, develop and retain a high-performing team across three functions — Engineering, Governance and Reporting</li> <li>Set clear direction and accountability for each function, developing your direct reports into leaders in their own right</li> <li>Build a culture of engineering excellence, curiosity and continuous improvement</li> <li>Influence and educate senior stakeholders across the business — building data literacy and trust in data assets</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What skills and experience do I need for this role?</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}">Essential</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience (typically 8+ years) in data engineering, data platform or data leadership roles, with at least 3 years at a senior or head-of level</li> <li>Deep hands-on experience with GCP and BigQuery — you must have built and scaled data platforms on this stack</li> <li>Experience across multiple data domains — ideally at least two of Customer, Commercial and Operations</li> <li>Proven track record of evolving a business's data architecture — you can point to concrete examples of how you changed the way a business ingests, stores and consumes its data</li> <li>Strong understanding of data governance principles — data quality, metadata management, mastering and lineage</li> <li>Experience working with or alongside a technology partner or platform team (similar to our Ingenuity relationship)</li> <li>Demonstrated use of AI in data engineering contexts — AI-assisted pipeline development, automated quality monitoring, or similar</li> <li>Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills — able to influence at Director and C-suite level</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer goods</li> <li>Familiarity with Dataform, dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks</li> <li>Experience with data cataloguing or governance tooling (Collibra, Alation, DataHub or equivalent)</li> <li>Exposure to ML/AI platform requirements — understanding what good data foundations look like to enable data science and personalisation</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What’s in it for me?</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Career Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.</li> <li>Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Enhanced Leave</strong></p> <ul> <li>25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.</li> <li>Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!</li> <li>Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.</li> <li>Up to 10 days compassionate leave.</li> <li>Buy back up to 3 days each year.</li> <li>Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellbeing Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.</li> <li>Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.</li> <li>State-of-the-art on-site gym.</li> <li>Access to our on-site physio.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li>Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.</li> <li>Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.</li> <li>Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.</li> <li>On-site staff shop.</li> <li>Know someone who would be perfect for THG? title: DevOps Engineer
description: About us Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator. The role We're looking for a DevOps Engineer with 4+ years of experience to join our growing platform engineering team in London. You'll be embedded in the teams building and operating Encord's core infrastructure, ensuring our platform is performant, reliable, observable, and scalable. You'll drive a culture of automation, performance, and resilience through individual contributions and collaboration with multiple squads. What You'll Do CI/CD & Deployment Own and continuously improve deployment pipelines; partner closely with developers to review infrastructure changes, streamline release processes, and champion DevOps best practices across the engineering group. Infrastructure & Cloud Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure on GCP and AWS; manage Kubernetes clusters, networking, and storage at petabyte scale, with infrastructure-as-code as the default. Automation & Tooling Drive developer productivity by building, guiding, and reviewing automation and internal tooling efforts across the engineering group; eliminate manual toil wherever it exists. Performance & Capacity Profile and optimise services handling large-scale data pipelines; perform capacity planning for storage and compute-intensive workloads. Work with squads to establish performance benchmarks and expectations. Reliability & Availability Define and own SLIs/SLOs/SLAs for critical services; build alerting, runbooks, and incident response processes; lead postmortems with a blameless culture. Observability Instrument services with distributed tracing, logging, and metrics (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, GCP Dashboards or similar); build infrastructure, define best practices, and work with each squad to ensure every service is observable before it goes to production. What We're Looking For 4+ years of hands-on DevOps, platform engineering, or SRE experience in a production environment. Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation at scale. Proven experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi) and configuration management. Strong fundamentals in designing, building, and maintaining resilient distributed and/or high performance systems. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerised workloads in cloud environments (GCP and/or AWS). Solid understanding of networking, operating systems, and database technologies. Experience with observability fundamentals metrics, logs, traces, and alerting. Tech stack We are technology agnostic at Encord and not looking for experience across all of these — as long as you're open to learning, please apply. Backend: Python Frontend: TypeScript and React Deployment: Kubernetes Infrastructure: GCP Machine learning: PyTorch, CUDA, Ray Why Encord Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays Annual learning & development budget Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe Company lunches twice a week Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director of Quality Assurance
description: At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world. The Role: As Director of Quality Assurance, you will lead our Quality function across three core areas: the quality management system, design quality assurance including software quality assurance, and supplier quality assurance including QC activities. As we approach on-market release, you will also prepare the QMS for customer facing activities including post-market surveillance and complaint handling. This is a player-coach role: hands-on leadership rather than pure people-management. You will set direction and develop the team, but you will also write procedures, make decisions, and stay close to the product and organisation needs. You will work as a direct partner to our engineering teams and alongside our dedicated Regulatory Affairs leadership. Regulatory is not part of this role, but a function you will collaborate closely with. At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day. Responsibilities: Team Leadership: Lead and develop our existing Quality team, instilling and maintaining a high performance culture. Ensure the CoMind QMS complies with the FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820, harmonised with ISO 13485) and 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and signatures, while remaining customer focused and aligned with business needs. Audit Leadership: Lead our annual ISO 13485 certification audit, FDA inspection readiness and own the internal, supplier, and customer audit programmes. Design Quality Assurance: Oversee design controls and design transfer to manufacturing including the DHFs and DHRs, ISO 14971 risk management, IEC 62366 useability, UDI requirement, and quality assurance across an integrated product spanning electronics, optics, and software. Provide oversight and guidance on software development processes including IEC 62304 software development processes, Software as Medical Device (SaMD) classification, and FDA's SaMD/AI-ML guidance. Cybersecurity: Provide oversight and guidance on cybersecurity aspects impacting product and business processes, including FDA's premarket cybersecurity guidance (Section 524B) Supplier & Manufacturing Quality: Lead supplier qualification, supplier audits, and manufacturing quality as we build toward commercial production. Work with suppliers to ensure effective Quality Assurance and Quality Control processes are implemented. Establish processes for maintaining Device Master Records, and transfer of batch records to CoMind. Post-Market Quality: Create the post-market side of the QMS from the ground up as we launch, including complaint handling, product analytics, and on-market quality processes Work with the RA function to compile Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSUR), vigilance reporting / MDR reporting, or field corrective actions/recalls in line with EU MDR/FDA obligations. Provide oversight and guidance on clinical evaluation / clinical data quality. Skills & Experience: Extensive leadership experience in Quality Assurance within an ISO 13485 environment including product design, manufacturing and commercial customer-facing operations A strong track record of building and managing high-performing Quality teams. Expert command of the core Quality toolkit: QMS, ISO 13485, design controls, ISO 14971 risk management, CAPA, validation, and supplier quality. Experience hosting and leading audits, including annual certification audits. Preferred audit certifications (ASQ CQE/CQA/CMQ-OE, RAC, Lead Auditor certification) Background in medical devices, ideally complex or integrated products. Strong candidates from diagnostics, IVD or pharma will also be considered. Experience in software-intensive / connected-devices Working knowledge of FDA / EU MDR and UK CA regulatory frameworks SaMD/software quality experience, human factors, or cybersecurity awareness A hands-on operator. You are comfortable writing SOPs and making decisions yourself, not just directing others. A record of staying and building - you are motivated by the journey and the chance to shape a function Benefits: Company equity plan so all employees share in the success of the company Salary-sacrifice pension scheme Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded) Group life assurance at 4x annual income Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals Unlimited holiday allowance (+ bank holidays) and one week of remote working per quarter Lunch voucher (£10) every day for JustEat and free dinner on those days where you need to work later Twice weekly deliveries of fresh fruit and an extensive selection of snacks and drinks YuLife subscription, allowing you to turn your daily steps and meditation into discounts at a range of stores Compensation: £120K – £140K • Offers Equity • Salary £120K – £140K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p>At Anaplan, we are looking for a strong Senior Platform Engineer to join our team. </p> <p>Are you a creative problem solver who can both give and receive feedback? Do you lead with inclusion, collaboration, and openness? Do you have strong experience with high-scale B2B and B2C platforms?<br><br>As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll be crafting and helping build the next generation of the Anaplan Platform. You’re comfortable with both full-stack systems design for the hybrid cloud as well as hands-on distributed systems programming with extensive knowledge of Java, JVM, Rust, Linux internals and container orchestration.</p> <p><br><strong>The Role</strong><br>We're looking for experienced engineers who've built real products at scale and apply that same rigor to platform engineering. You'll engineer new platforms as products, not just operate existing infrastructure. You understand user experience, reliability, and technical debt from shipping production systems. You'll design platforms that are extensible, observable, and maintainable, enabling internal teams to build on top of them while handling the complexity underneath.<br><br><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p><strong>Kubernetes Engineering & Automation</strong><br>You don't just write Helm charts or YAML manifests; you extend the Kubernetes API.</p> <ul> <li>Custom Operators: Proven ability to write Kubernetes Operators (using Kubebuilder or Operator SDK) to manage complex, stateful application lifecycles.</li> <li>Control Plane Logic: Deep understanding of reconciliation loops, custom resource definitions (CRDs), and how to automate operational knowledge into code</li> </ul> <p><strong>Scalable Microservices & Distributed Systems</strong><br>You build for high concurrency, low latency, and eventual consistency.</p> <ul> <li>High-Scale SaaS: 10+ years of experience building and operating production-grade SaaS products. You have first-hand experience with the "death by a thousand cuts" that<br>comes with scaling to millions of requests.</li> <li>Systems Programming: Advanced proficiency in Go, Rust, or JVM-based languages, with a focus on writing memory-efficient and thread-safe code.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Deep-Tier Cloud Storage & Persistence</strong><br>You understand the physics of data.</p> <ul> <li>Storage Internals: We need more than S3 API knowledge. You should understand the performance characteristics, limitations, and cost-drivers of S3, NFS, and enterprise<br>storage like NetApp OnTap or AWS FSx.</li> <li>Data Locality: Experience managing data persistence across hybrid environments (Public Cloud vs. Private DC).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Maturity (The "SRE" DNA)</strong><br>You believe that "if it isn't monitored, it doesn't exist."</p> <ul> <li>Instrumentation: Expert-level experience with OpenTelemetry. You don't just look at metrics; you design the telemetry that allows for deep-dive distributed tracing and root-cause analysis.</li> <li>Observability Infrastructure: Hands-on experience scaling Prometheus and Grafana to<br>handle high-cardinality data.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Your Skills</strong><br>· BS degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience as a professional Platform Engineer.<br>· Substantial experience in Java, RUST programming experience<br>· Proven experience in building and operating a SaaS product at scale.<br>· Proven cloud experience using observability and operating workloads in Kubernetes.<br>· Experience with cloud storage S3, NFS, NetApp OnTap, AWS FSX<br>· Distributed Systems and programming techniques.<br>· Monitoring and metrics infrastructure (OTEL, Prometheus, Grafana).<br>· Cloud (AWS / GCP/ Azure / Private DC).<br>· Bonus: Experience with AI/ML, Natural Language</p> <p><strong>Technologies you’ll work with:</strong><br>· Programming languages: GoLang, Java11, Kotlin, Rust, Python<br>· Storage & Persistence: S3, NFS<br>· Container and Orchestration: Kubernetes/Containers (Docker)/Rancher RKE<br>· Cloud providers: AWS, GCP, Azure, Private Data Centers<br>· Observability/Telemetry: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana<br>· Deployment: Jenkins, ArgoCD</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. title: Founding Data Analyst
description: Our Mission Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance? Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist. We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world. We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them. The Role Dex runs on data. Our matching, our product decisions, our growth, our commercial bets all depend on understanding what's actually happening across the business, and right now that intelligence lives in too many places. This is a founding role to own the data foundation of Dex end to end: the data models underneath everything, the pipelines that connect our systems, and the data platform that the whole company (and our agents) builds on top of. We use agents for a huge amount of our analytical work, which means the quality of our data layer is a force multiplier. Get it right and every person and every agent at Dex gets faster and sharper. You'll own how data is modelled, how it flows between our systems, and how internal teams self-serve on top of it, building on what's already driving the business rather than starting from a blank page. As the first dedicated data hire, you'll set the standards and build the function out behind you as Dex grows. It's a chance to define how an AI-native company builds on its data from the ground up, in a market with a real dearth of well-built data foundations. We think there's a generational company to be built in this space, and we believe it's going to be Dex. What You’ll Do Core data modelling : Design and own the core data models that everything else depends on, making them clean, trusted and easy to build on. Modelling at source : Work inside the product and engineering codebase to ensure data is captured and structured correctly from the start, before it ever reaches the warehouse. Pipelines : Build and maintain the pipelines that connect our systems, so data flows through the business correctly and reliably. Self-serve platform : Make the data platform genuinely self-serve, so product, growth, commercial and ops teams (and our agents) can answer their own questions without coming to you. Agents as consumers : Treat agents as first-class consumers of the data layer, structuring data so they can do analytical work accurately and at scale. Metrics that matter : Partner with the team on the metrics that matter, from acquisition and activation through to matching quality and commercial performance. Answers, not just queries : Turn ambiguous business questions into the right data model, the right metric and a clear answer. Standards : Set the standards for data quality, definitions and instrumentation across Dex. What we’re looking for You've built the data foundation for a consumer product or marketplace before, and you know what good looks like at scale. You're an engineer and an analyst. You can model and pipe the data, and read what it's telling you about the business. Comfortable reading existing code and finding your way through a codebase you didn't write. You can pick up how a system models and emits its data, and confidently make changes within it. Fluent across a modern analytics stack (a cloud warehouse, a transformation layer, orchestration and BI), with views on what to use when. We're open to changing our current choices and want someone who can tell us where they're right and where they aren't. Commercially and product minded. You care about the metric and the decision it drives, not just the query. You think about the platform, not the one-off answer. You build things other people (and agents) can stand on. Intelligent, ambitious, with strong judgement. A good person who's fun to work with and makes things happen without being asked. What We Offer Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support Gym membership & wellness benefits Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip MacBook Pro + team kit "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support Interview process We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect: We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy. title: Platform Engineer
description: About us We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents. We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day. Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing. Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things. Want to join our pack? Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets. A day in the life As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on. This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets. Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration. We embrace modern development practices: All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience. We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day. We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start. As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities ü Build and maintain secure platform foundations Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on. Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable. Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it. Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads. ü Make our security controls provable Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements. Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort. Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved. Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling. ü Strengthen access and identity controls Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege. Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities. Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review. ü Extend our platform standards beyond AWS Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate. Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are. ü Team collaboration Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions. Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously. Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews. Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance. ü Self development Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan. Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset. Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship. Your skills and experience We are looking for someone with: Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure). Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar. Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines. A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption. Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python. Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously. We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other: A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation. Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud. The interview process This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom. Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team. Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need. Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise. Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security. About the team The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about. Our tech stack We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn. You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas. Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics. To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean. We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding. We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices. We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud. Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare Salary range: £55,000 — £65,000 GBP Ways of working On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset. You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day. We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively. We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support. Inclusion at ManyPets We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won't discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback. If you'd like to read more about this, please download our Approach to Inclusion policy. Reasonable adjustments and support If you need any help, support, or advice at any point during the hiring process please email Connect with us! title: Senior New Business Manager
description: About WPP Production We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world. About WPP WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com . A Hybrid working model We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. What does a Senior New Business Manager do at WPP Production? The role The Senior New Business Manager plays a critical role in driving growth for WPP Production, leading complex, high-value opportunities end-to-end and shaping how we respond to and win new business. This is a strategic and creative role, responsible for defining the narrative, positioning and overall solution behind each pitch. You will take ownership of how we translate client challenges into clear, differentiated and commercially compelling responses. Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will lead the development of integrated proposals — bringing together strategy, operations, creative and production into a single, cohesive story. You will also help shape the strategic approach for each opportunity, ensuring the structure, messaging and positioning reflect WPP Production's proposition and competitive advantage. You will balance creative thinking with commercial understanding — clearly articulating how our operating models work, why they are effective, and the value they deliver for clients. This is an opportunity to work on some of the most exciting and complex opportunities in the industry, with real influence over how we position ourselves and how we win. Key areas of responsibility Lead and own high-value opportunities end-to-end, from initial brief through to submission and presentation Define the pitch narrative, positioning and "red thread", ensuring a clear, compelling & cohesive story throughout Design and articulate client solutions, including operating models and value propositions, clearly demonstrating how they work and the value they deliver Translate complex inputs into clear, structured and persuasive client-facing responses Lead the development of high impact written content, including pitch decks, RFI/RFP responses and presentations, owning the narrative across all content Present and support client-facing sessions, including credentials presentations and pitch meetings Lead and align senior stakeholders around a single, cohesive response Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across WPP Production, WPP OpCos and partners, enabling effective collaboration across opportunities Ensure all outputs are strategically strong, consistent and clearly differentiated Collaborate across WPP agencies on integrated, multi-disciplinary opportunities Contribute to and help shape commercial strategy, including pricing narrative and value framing Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to ensure WPP Production's positioning remains competitive Identify opportunities to improve & drive innovation in how we approach, structure and deliver pitches Mentor and support New Business Managers and Executives, raising standards across the team What good looks like (key requirements) 7+ years' experience in a new business or client growth roles within a creative, production or agency environment Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to shape clear, persuasive narratives from complex inputs Strong strategic thinking, able to translate client challenges into structured, compelling solutions and responses Proven experience leading complex pitch or proposal processes end-to-end Confident communicator, with experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple high-value opportunities and large volumes of content simultaneously Strong commercial capability, with experience shaping proposals and contributing to pricing approach, value framing and commercial models Proactive and solutions-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and a drive to identify opportunities and deliver outcomes Collaborative in approach, able to bring together multiple stakeholders and disciplines into a single aligned response Strong understanding of the advertising production landscape and broader marketing ecosystem Curious and engaged, with an interest in innovation and the evolving content and production landscape Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Word and Excel, with a good eye for structure and presentation #LI - HYBRID #LI - RH1 Why work here: At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment. title: Backend Engineer, Subscriptions
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, one of the largest online food ordering and delivery platforms in the world. As part of this role, you'll join one of our Subscriptions teams in London, focused on the core proposition and working across our three subscription programmes - DashPass, Deliveroo Plus, and Wolt+. You'll work closely with engineering teams across the US and Europe, as part of the Global Subscription organisation, to build and evolve the shared subscriptions capabilities that power loyalty and membership experiences for millions of customers worldwide. We're hiring backend engineers who want to be at the front line of what engineering looks like in the age of AI. 💡 Why Subscriptions? An AI-first team by design. We don't use AI as a productivity add-on - we treat agentic coding as a core engineering discipline. We expect our engineers to build with AI agents, to challenge what's possible when the human-in-the-loop is a multiplier rather than a bottleneck, and to push the boundaries of what a small, focused team can ship. Real ownership, real impact. Our subscription programmes are touching millions of users daily. You'll own features end-to-end - from the idea through production - and see your work matter at scale. Cross-org engineering at the frontier. Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt are working together in order to align subscription experiences across three of the world's leading delivery platforms. This is engineering at the intersection of product ambition and international complexity. A small team that punches above its weight. We're a cross-functional team: Backend, Mobile, Web, Product, Design, and Data - all in the same room. No handoff theatre. You'll move fast, ship iteratively, and be around people who take craft seriously. 🤖 AI-First Engineering - What This Means Here We're building teams at the forefront of agentic coding. This isn't about using Copilot to autocomplete boilerplate. We mean engineers who: Design workflows where AI agents handle entire task loops, from spec to PR. Think in terms of orchestration: what does a human review, what does the agent own? Build internal tooling and abstractions that make AI-assisted development faster and more reliable for the whole team. Stay curious and ahead of the curve - trying new models, agents, and tools as they emerge, and forming strong opinions about what's genuinely useful vs. hype. If you find yourself naturally asking "can an agent do this?" before reaching for the keyboard, you'll fit right in. 🔍 What We're Looking For Across all roles Strong engineering fundamentals - you've built and shipped software that runs at scale, and you understand what that entails: testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability. Genuine enthusiasm for AI-first development. You use AI tools daily and have formed real opinions about how to get the most out of them. Ownership mentality: you drive projects forward, communicate clearly across teams and time zones, and don't wait to be told what to do. Collaborative instincts - the Subscriptions domain sits at the intersection of consumer mobile, web, backend, and data. Cross-functional work is the norm, not the exception. 🙌 About You You've built and shipped real software - products, platforms, APIs, apps - and you know what it takes to keep things running reliably in production. You have opinions about architecture but hold them lightly. You write tests. You read the alerts. You don't leave loose ends. What sets you apart right now is that you're genuinely excited about where engineering is going. You've been experimenting with AI agents and agentic coding workflows - not because someone told you to, but because you couldn't help yourself. You think about how to redesign your development loop from first principles, not how to bolt AI onto the way you already work. You communicate well, collaborate easily across disciplines, and care about the product as much as the code. You're the kind of engineer who asks "what's the best way to..." and then actually follows through. 🌍 Where You'll Work These roles are based in our tech hub in London. title: Delivery Manager Genflex
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🐙 Kraken Generation Flex The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change. Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU. This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service. You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform . You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated. Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding: Customer : What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them? Product : How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required? Engineering : How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work? Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution . 🚀 What you'll own Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service. Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform , including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex. Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding. Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset. Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements , making sure each group understands what is needed from the others. Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required. Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules. Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective. Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early. Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition. Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next. Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery. Review and interpret customer technical documentation including: Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs) Network and communications diagrams Site and asset specifications PPC and controller documentation Modbus register maps IP addressing and network information Functional Design Specifications Metering and telemetry information Hardware and connectivity requirements Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together. Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker. Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information. Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process , ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready. Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including: Gateway installation and connectivity Operational acceptance testing Kraken market and service testing Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders. Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams. Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones. Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking. The ability to read and understand an Electrical Single Line Diagram (SLD) and use it to understand the electrical architecture of a site. A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications , including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity. Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems. Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment. Excellent communication skills , with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action. Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties. A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously. The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly. A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality. A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving. A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end , rather than treating the software platform as a black box. A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment , comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function. Language: professional fluency in English . A second European language would be preferable. ⭐️ Bonus points Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial. Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources. A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA ) Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets. Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services. Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration. Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning. Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity. title: General Counsel

description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong>, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer</strong> to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will <strong>own Canonical's legal, regulatory and governance posture</strong> and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and judgement</strong> alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment.</p> <p><strong><em>Location: </em></strong><em>This role will be based remotely in EMEA time zones, with an option to be office based in London, UK.</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting it's structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas.</li> <li>Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly.</li> <li>Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team.</li> <li>Owning public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advising the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and supporting in Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Owning the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Leading intellectual property and open source licensing strategy, including copyleft, trademark and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Owning the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation.</li> <li>Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality.</li> <li>Advising on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>A degree in law, or equivalent, and an active licence to practice in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.</li> <li>Substantial senior in-house experience in a global technology or software business.</li> <li>Proven experience leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>Technology related experience of: <ul> <li>negotiating and owning commercial technology contracts, including enterprise software and subscriptions, channel and reseller agreements, hardware manufacturer agreements, cloud and services</li> <li>advising on open source licensing, including permissive and copyleft licences, and familiarity with how open source communities operate.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Experience of, or demonstrable readiness for, public company governance: listing preparation, board and committee support, disclosure and controls.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and share ideas without hesitation.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.</li> <li>International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practicing as counsel inside a listed company.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>
